searchText: The benchmarks are available as json files here: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/tree/master/core/vm/testdata/precompiles . Happy to answer any questions (the new benchmarks for 4844 are not yet in master branch. Those are on eip-4844 on `holiman` fork of go-ethereum) Hey <@898563924440543283> , i'm trying to start a local testnet with this branch. For some reason, it's not starting the auth server. I have set the ttd in my `genesis.json` . What's the status of `SHARDING_FORK_{VERSION,EPOCH}` ? They're not in the consensus-specs repo, yet they are in https://github.com/eth-clients/eth2-networks/blob/master/shared/mainnet/config.yaml#L43 (and the current SHARDING_FORK_VERSION in eth2-networks collides with EIP4844_FORK_VERSION in consensus-specs...) It is not in use anywhere. CL spec `sharding` is the full dandsharding draft now, but we haven't added `fork.md` yet. We likely won't need `SHARDING_FORK_{VERSION,EPOCH}` config before EIP-4844 is done. ok - I have a PR open ( https://github.com/eth-clients/eth2-networks/pull/81) to add `EIP4844_FORK_VERSION` there; currently it bumps `SHARDING_FORK_VERSION` but I guess the correct thing to do would be to remove it altogether then. I know Nimbus has refs to `SHARDING_FORK_VERSION` but we might remove it there; do any other clients foresee issues if we remove SHARDING_FORK_VERSION from the eth2-networks config? I'll echo <@804047680195395675> 's questions hey dcbuilder. Devnet v2 is no longer healthy and one can no longer peer with it. Once CL clients are ready I'll prepare another guide for devnet v3. Is this when running the eip4844 interop tests or something else? Pawan's working on a separate setup that starts post-merge This is unrelated but I'm getting `null` s in resposnes to `engine_getBlobsBundleV1` where I would have expected empty lists ``` { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": { "blockHash": "0x79aa468188a22f8956a769e3798eb7e0e31031ea7c3144f7763aff53f0fca828", "kzgs": null, "blobs": null } } ``` For the interop tests I noticed the interop dockerfile needed an update to specify the shanghai block: https://github.com/Inphi/eip4844-interop/pull/72/files will take a look at why we're getting those nulls <@607055410104500244> fix for the null issue https://github.com/mdehoog/go-ethereum/pull/68 Prysm passing every 4844 spec test 🎉 (Thanks again <@415109946682769408> ) I'm ready to interop with an EL client. Is https://github.com/mdehoog/go-ethereum/commit/d5563a130124ad7035f0e1685ca95961a15647f3 the best one?

What's the status of `SHARDING_FORK_{VERSION,EPOCH}` ?

excerpts.author: hsiaowei
excerpts.content: It is not in use anywhere. CL spec `sharding` is the full dandsharding draft now, but we haven't added `fork.md` yet. We likely won't need `SHARDING_FORK_{VERSION,EPOCH}` config before EIP-4844 is done.

excerpts.author: henridf
excerpts.content: ok - I have a PR open ( https://github.com/eth-clients/eth2-networks/pull/81) to add `EIP4844_FORK_VERSION` there; currently it bumps `SHARDING_FORK_VERSION` but I guess the correct thing to do would be to remove it altogether then.
